sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Brokerage of Ginned Raw Cotton and Synthetic Yarns

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English Common Law heritage, modified by locally enacted statutes and customary land law; unitary national regulatory system with no sub-state tax distinction
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Double Taxation Agreement between Samoa and New Zealand
Double Taxation Agreement between Samoa and Australia
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering and Prevention of Terrorism Financing Act 2007 (as amended by the Money Laundering and Prevention of Terrorism Financing (Amendment) Act 2015); Money Laundering and Prevention of Terrorism Financing Regulations issued by the Samoan Financial Intelligence Unit; International Companies Act 1987 (as amended); International Companies (Amendment) Act 2015; Financial Institutions Act 1996; Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) AML/CFT Directions and Beneficial Ownership Guidance Notes

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport (biographical page) of each individual Ultimate Beneficial Owner and Director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the relevant national jurisdiction (e.g., Chinese Passport Authority, Hong Kong Immigration Department)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (where the issuing jurisdiction is a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention) OR Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate majority shareholder (above the applicable threshold)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the ultimate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization at a Samoan diplomatic post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Six-month bank reference letter for the UBO / settlor / funder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization; banker branch seal plus apostille is accepted where the source jurisdiction is a Contracting Party to the Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Identity or police clearance certificate (only when enhanced due diligence is triggered)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police / criminal records agency of country of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory, refreshed, and documented screening of every UBO, director, shareholder, signatory, and the ultimate counterparty chain against (i) the Samoan Financial Intelligence Unit domestic PEP and criminal lists, (ii) the OFAC SDN List, (iii) the United Nations Consolidated Security Council Sanctions List, and (iv) HM Treasury / EU consolidated lists as secondary references. Enhanced due diligence applies to any match or to individuals connected with high-risk jurisdictions. Screening is refreshed at onboarding, every 90 days during the incorporation process, and upon any trigger event; results are retained by the licensed registered agent for no less than five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Companies and Business Registry of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — online search and name reservation via the Samoa Companies Registry portal (https://www.mcil.gov.ws), supplemented by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) register of International Companies (https://www.sifa.ws)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names must be filed in English/Latin-script letters; the Samoan alphabet and orthography (including the koma liliu ʻokina and the macron) may be used, but a Latin-script English transliteration is required for every name component. Names must not cause confusion with any earlier registered company, trade mark, or statutory body. A Chinese-character secondary trading name is not recognized in the International Companies register; if used commercially, it must be carried as a transliterated trading name and must be reserved separately with the relevant trade mark and domain authorities.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Association with a regulated profession (e.g., Attorney, Solicitor, Auditor, Broker)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name reservation is refused, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file a written review request with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, setting out grounds of removal of confusion or prior approval. The Registrar must respond in writing within 14 days; an adverse determination may be appealed to the Supreme Court of Samoa under the International Companies Act 1987 / Companies Act 2013. Alternatively, the applicant may lodge a new reservation with a distinctive prefix or suffix at the same fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only as a supplementary communications address: each International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa, which is the office of its resident SIFA-licensed registered agent, where statutory records, the UBO register, and the registered agent's AML files are physically kept. A standalone virtual office in Samoa does not satisfy the International Companies Act 1987 registered-office requirement. For ISIC 4620 brokerage of ginned raw cotton, remote management via email and order-management platforms is fully acceptable, as no physical warehousing or local trading floor is statutorily required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified annual risk of unannounced inspection for a non-licensed, low-risk trading vehicle is approximately 5%; for the registered agent's office itself, SIFA exercises scheduled and trigger-based on-site inspections, so the true probability of a spot-check on the file cluster is materially higher, approximately 20-25%, if the agent is due for SIFA routine examination.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee for offshore International Companies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office, resident registered agent, and company secretary (first 12 months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Samoan offshore trust and corporate service providers

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT onboarding file, UBO register establishment, PEP/OFAC/UN screening (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for UBO piercing and sanctions-screening workload

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille / Consular legalization bundle (up to four UBO documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and apostille authority in source jurisdiction; Samoan Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade / SIFA for local countersignature
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing tariff of the relevant issuing jurisdiction, approximately USD 60-120 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sanctions-list alert maintenance and 90-day re-screening refresh (12 months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed per-entity pricing adopted by licensed Samoan agents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Dossier translation, transliteration certification, and courier/document delivery
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark, USD 60-90 per certified translation and courier per published DHL tariff

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, ss. 4-10 (incorporation), s. 62 (registered office), s. 74 (registered agent); Companies Act 2001 applied only where expressly imported by the International Companies Act
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&A) filed with Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow requirement; authorized capital declared at par (commonly US$1,000,000 split into US$1 shares) with allotment satisfied by contractual subscription without cash contribution
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the incorporation of the Company under the International Companies Act 1987 be accepted, and the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed be adopted in full. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT one fully paid ordinary share be allotted to the sole subscriber at par, and the authorized share capital structure be ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office be established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT [Name] be appointed sole Director, and [Name] be appointed Secretary, each to act until replaced by board or member resolution. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Corporate Seal be approved, and the Director and Secretary are jointly authorized to execute all statutory filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Office, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the licensed registered agent to the IC Registrar. The name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing domestic or international company or protected trademark in Samoa. The name may include 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' and is reserved for 30 days pending incorporation.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of licensed agent's ICS license
Written confirmation of no conflict on the register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or conditionally accepted, the agent may file an alternative name (max 3 per application) or submit a written appeal to the Registrar within 14 days for administrative review under IC Act s. 5.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent (IC trust company) and Notary Public in Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the M&A with an objects clause covering international brokerage, export trading, and wholesale of raw cotton bales and synthetic yarns (ISIC 4620). The sole subscriber executes the M&A before a notary; the registered agent countersigns the consent to act as agent and registered office holder.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (2 originals)
Notarized power of attorney to the agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the M&A is returned by the Registrar for defective objects or share provisions, a supplemental amendment under IC Act s. 13 is notarized and re-filed; no new incorporation fee applies for amendments made within the original application window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Office, Apia (counter or online portal via licensed agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the executed M&A, agent consent, and the government filing fee of US$100. The agent lodges the application on behalf of the subscriber; the Registrar examines compliance with the International Companies Act 1987 and, upon satisfaction, endorses the certificate date.
required_dossiers: Two certified copies of the M&A
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition, the applicant has 14 days to cure by amended filing; failure results in the application being deemed withdrawn, with the fee refundable less an administrative deduction, and a fresh application may be lodged immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Opening of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the assigned IC registration number. The company is then required to open the statutory registers (members, directors, secretaries, charges) at the registered office in Samoa and to maintain them in English.
required_dossiers: Oath/declaration of compliance by the agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any clerical error in the Certificate (name, date, or registered number) is rectified by a written request to the Registrar under IC Act s. 8, with correction issued within 5 business days at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Ancillary Government Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL Companies Office and Samoa Ministry for Revenue (TIN Unit)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting to adopt the registered office, appoint officers, approve the corporate seal, and open authority for bank account operations. File for a tax identification number (TIN) for the International Company's local representative account pursuant to the Tax Administration Act 2012, and file the initial beneficial ownership return with the Registrar.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficient TIN or beneficial ownership filings are cured by re-submission through the Revenue e-Service portal within 14 days without penalty; registry rejection notices are appealable to MCIL's Internal Review Committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable to a paper-brokerage International Company; incorporation oversight rests solely with the Registrar of International Companies, MCIL. Should physical warehousing of cotton bales later be added, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) Import/Export and Trade Division would require a commercial trade license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating or manufacturing permit required for the brokerage and export of raw cotton bales under ISIC 4620; a customs export declaration is effected through the Samoa Customs Service under the Ministry for Revenue without a pre-export industrial license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - administrative office and trading activity; no EIA registration or development consent required because the entity creates no physical land disturbance, manufacturing, or processing of raw cotton
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the current model: zero wastewater discharge, zero VOC point sources, and no solid hazardous waste generation. If a warehouse is introduced, compliance with PUMA development consent conditions and the Environment Management Act 2004 discharge thresholds will apply, specifically effluent BOD ≤ 20 mg/L and prohibition of unlicensed waste storage.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate for the Apia registered office from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA); structural load and occupancy clearance per MCIL building compliance for office use; workplace notification and accident-compensation registration with the Accident Compensation Corporation of Samoa; no heavy machinery or cotton-dust exposure controls applicable until physical handling operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of Samoa, Independent State of Samoa, Apia (formerly Inland Revenue Division); official web portal: Samoa Ministry for Revenue Taxpayer Access Point Service (TAPS) at https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign parent or offshore International Company (IC) applies to the Ministry for Revenue using Form TIN-01 (Application for a Taxpayer Identification Number - Non-Resident Company), submitting: (i) Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) IC registration certificate; (ii) certificate of incorporation and memorandum/articles of association; (iii) board resolution appointing the registered agent; (iv) certified passport copies of directors and shareholders; and (v) registered office consent from the licensed agent. The TIN is issued within 5-10 business days. Where the IC makes taxable supplies connectable with Samoa (uncommon for pure offshore export brokerage), it separately files a VAGST registration application and obtains a VAGST registration number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - International Companies incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 are exempt from Samoan income tax, VAGST on offshore supplies, stamp duties, and withholding taxes on distributions to non-residents; the only periodic charge is the annual government licence fee (WST 100 to WST 1,200 depending on authorised share capital) payable to SIFA, and the IC must not carry on business with Samoan residents or derive Samoa-source income in order to retain this exempt classification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or elective flow-through mechanism exists under Samoan tax law; the unitary regime taxes domestic corporations at entity level at 27% and exempts ICs territorially. The sole relevant election is one of corporate form at incorporation: a company may elect for International Company status under the International Companies Act 1987, which statutory election renders the entity a fully exempt offshore corporation. Hybrid mismatch elections and US-style entity classification elections are not recognised. An IC may further elect to be a Limited Life Company, an International Exempt Trust, or to register as a foreign-owned domestic company, each with distinct tax consequences. The IC Act also permits nomination of a resident director without changing the exempt tax character.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 50,000 per annum of taxable supplies in Samoa (approximately USD 18,500); for an International Company engaged purely in export brokerage of raw cotton bales, supplies are zero-rated, and registration is generally required only if the IC has Samoan domestic taxable turnover or chooses to register to recover input VAGST on local establishment costs. No threshold applies to importations of goods into Samoa, as VAGST is collected at the border regardless of importer turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not currently mandate real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping for exporters as of the 2025 tax year. Statutory VAGST returns and tax invoices are filed and retained via the Ministry for Revenue TAPS e-filing portal, and the Samoan Customs Service operates ASYCUDA World as the national single-window electronic customs clearance system, requiring the lodgement of export declarations and supporting documentation in electronic form. All VAGST records, including export substantiation, must be retained for a minimum of 7 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supply of raw cotton bales is zero-rated for VAGST where: (i) the goods are physically exported from Samoa by the supplier within 28 days of supply (or such extended period as the Chief Executive Officer of the Ministry for Revenue approves); (ii) property in the goods passes to an overseas purchaser; (iii) payment is received in a convertible foreign currency; and (iv) the supplier retains the prescribed documentary evidence. International brokerage services in respect of raw cotton located outside Samoa, and logistics services performed offshore, are treated as offshore services and either zero-rated or outside the scope of VAGST. The IC must report the supply as zero-rated on its VAGST return (if registered) and must not issue a tax invoice charging 15% VAGST. The zero-rating claim attaches to the export, not the exporter's tax-exempt IC status, so documentary proof must be independently maintained.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic e-declaration with Customs-assigned export reference number)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing shipment from Apia Wharf or Faleolo International Airport to the foreign buyer
Commercial Invoice and Packing List matching the customs declaration and payment terms
Inward Remittance Certificate or authenticated SWIFT transaction report evidencing receipt of export sale proceeds in foreign currency
SIFA Certificate of Good Standing for the International Company confirming valid tax-exempt status and current paid annual government licence fee
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may audit zero-rated export claims for up to 5 years from the date of assessment. Under the Tax Administration Act 2015, shortfall penalties of 20% apply for failure to exercise reasonable care and 40% for fraudulent evasion, plus late payment interest of 2% per month compounded. The VAGST Act 2003 (as amended) provides additional monetary penalties and imprisonment up to 7 years for knowingly false export documentation or aiding tax evasion. Customs penalties may be imposed for misdeclared exports, and in extreme cases ASYCUDA export privileges may be suspended. For an International Company, engaging in undisclosed domestic Samoan trade or failure to maintain the offshore documentary chain triggers revocation of the exempt IC status under the International Companies Act 1987, exposing the entity retrospectively to 27% corporate income tax on Samoa-source income and 15% VAGST on infringing supplies, together with licence revocation and removal from the SIFA register.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), Apia — statutory regulator under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984 and Exchange Control Act 1976 (as amended), responsible for exchange-control policy, authorized-dealer licensing, and administration of the Exchange Control Regulations 1980, in coordination with the Financial Intelligence Unit under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2017.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) operates under a CBS-managed float tied to a trade-weighted currency basket. Current-account payments (trade settlement, commissions, and documented contract fees) are freely convertible through authorized dealers upon filing of a standard FX application; capital-account transfers involving Samoan residents require prior CBS approval. A Samoa International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 2012 qualifies as a non-resident entity: its foreign-currency treasury operations fall outside the domestic capital-control perimeter provided no business is conducted with Samoa residents, no WST source funds are used, and no Samoan-asset positions arise. Dividend and profit remittance from an IC is unrestricted when funded from a permitted foreign-currency account; no WST conversion or profit-remittance approval is engaged.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters of physical goods must declare exports to CBS through an authorized dealer, repatriate proceeds within the statutory period (generally six months from shipment), and surrender or offer for conversion any foreign-currency proceeds to an authorized dealer unless a CBS retention or foreign-currency-account exemption has been granted. The ISIC 4620 raw-cotton brokerage operates entirely offshore: legal title does not enter Samoa customs territory, and invoices flow from foreign gin mills directly to foreign spinning mills. Accordingly, no Samoan customs export declaration is triggered, no WST surrender obligation arises, and the IC may lawfully retain USD proceeds in a designated offshore-IC account.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD current account) and segregated Capital Escrow Account for the IC capital contribution
Operational Account (multi-currency) with cash-collateralized commercial LC issuance capability
Capital Escrow Account only — limited trade-services appetite for offshore ICs

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: FEASIBILITY: LOW. Samoa has no digital-EMI licensing category, and the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2017 does not authorize foreign EMIs to conduct clearing or account-keeping for a Samoa-licensed IC. Global EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, Dukascopy) generally decline Pacific offshore ICs owing to correspondent de-risking, restricted beneficiary-country coverage, and inability to verify Samoan IC registers in real time. Legal constraint: engaging an unregulated EMI may be treated as unauthorized banking business in Samoa. Recommended route: BSP SWIFT clearing coupled with a second-leg corporate account at a Singapore or Hong Kong licensed bank; no EMI dependency.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Samoa licensed banks generally require at least one director or designated signatory to attend an in-branch interview in Apia before account activation and before any LC facility is drawn. A remote video-verified interview may be accepted where the IC is introduced by a SIFA-licensed registered agent or trustee and all corporate records are certified by that agent; in practice, a physical visit of one beneficial owner or authorized signatory is required for USD-account opening and UCP600 LC issuance. Certified copies under the International Companies Act 2012 (certificate of incorporation, memorandum, register of directors and shareholders, UBO declaration, and board resolutions) are mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque UBO chain through nominee directors and trust-based shareholding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent certification of corporate registers; complete UBO declaration naming every natural person holding 10% or more; passport copies and residential proof of each UBO; notarized trust deed where a trust holds equity; reference letters from the introducing trust company and an existing OECD-listed bank

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-flow mismatch: brokerage without physical goods passing through Samoa
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed master supply contract between the foreign gin mill and the foreign spinner; itemized supplier invoices and cotton classing certificates (Universal Cotton Standards / USDA-classed); warehouse receipts and bills of lading for FOB/CIF legs; cargo insurance certificates; IC commission invoice evidencing an arm's-length brokerage fee

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and export-control flags on cotton origin countries or counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Origin-country certificate (Form A and phytosanitary equivalent); legal-entity passports of seller and buyer; sanctions-screening screenshot from World-Check or LexisNexis; LC terms expressly excluding sanctioned parties and vessels; commodity-specific provenance due diligence (no forced-labor taint) to satisfy bank ESG policies

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient economic substance and brass-plate characterization in Samoa
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease for the registered office; engagement letter with the SIFA-licensed registered agent and Samoan counsel; board minutes authorizing account opening, LC issuance, and treasury policy; evidence of board meetings held from Samoa; substance statement filed in the IC annual return to SIFA

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-equivalent commodity classification and unverified counterparty funding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commitment to 100% bank-channel settlement (no cash, no third-party payments); LC or documentary-collection payment terms embedded in each contract; bank statements showing funds received only from institution-verified accounts; standing undertaking to provide per-transaction source of funds within three business days

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: the foreign shareholder transmits USD via SWIFT MT103 to the IC's designated USD account at BSP Samoa; Field 70 Remittance Information must state 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION — [IC REGISTRATION NUMBER] UNDER IC ACT 2012 — SHAREHOLDER REF [XXX]'; the bank requires a board resolution and registered-agent capital confirmation. No CBS approval is triggered because the credit enters a non-resident foreign-currency account. The capital block is verified before any operating disbursement, and funds must not originate from a sanctioned institution or from cash deposits.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for commission rebates, freight, insurance, and interim supplier payments, with full beneficiary bank and IBAN details and Field 70 cross-references to contract and LC numbers; (ii) confirmed irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued by BSP Samoa under UCP600 (MT700), 100% cash-covered or backed by an approved credit line, with the IC as applicant and the foreign gin mill as beneficiary; (iii) documentary collections (D/P at sight or D/A up to 90 days) for lower-value shipments, routed through a correspondent bank in the seller's jurisdiction. USD clearing is channeled via BSP's international nostro network (prefer BSP Brisbane or BSP Port Moresby nostro legs) to minimize small-country intermediation risk; all outbound wires are matched against an approved treasury payment matrix to satisfy bank monitoring.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/WST offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) executed through an OECD-listed bank or BSP treasury desk — cash-settled with no onshore WST delivery
USD/WST spot foreign-exchange contract with a CBS-licensed authorized dealer for payment of Samoan-local statutory, registered-agent, and administrative fees

Cross-currency swap (CCS) between USD and a supplier settlement currency (CNY, AUD, or INR) under an ISDA 2002 master agreement with a licensed international counterparty, used only where supplier-side local currency settlement has been contractually agreed
FX option collar (call-spread/put-spread) purchased from a rated international bank to hedge a committed order book exceeding USD 2 million pending final USD/WST clearing inflection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee Payment and Annual Confirmation Statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Registrar of International Companies (Samoa International Finance Authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation; 30-day grace period permitted before delinquency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the annual fee for each month of arrears; failure to pay for three consecutive months may lead to a notice of impending strike-off; persistent default results in administrative dissolution and loss of limited liability protection.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Registrar of International Companies (through licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the registration renewal, no later than the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed resident agent and local registered office may trigger automatic suspension of the company's status and eventual strike-off from the register.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for a Samoa International Company unless required by a resolution of shareholders or by the Registrar for public interest reasons; companies with gross annual turnover exceeding WST 2,000,000 or with more than 25 shareholders may be directed to submit audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) if financial statements are voluntarily prepared; no local GAAP specifically mandated for International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A registered agent must file a Beneficial Ownership Register confirmation with the Registrar on an annual basis; any changes in shareholding or beneficial ownership must be reported within 14 days of the change, and the annual confirmation must state that the register is accurate and up-to-date.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% standard corporate rate; 0% statutory exemption for International Companies (ICs)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies Act 1987 s.196: ICs are exempt from income tax, withholding tax, stamp duty and all other Samoa taxes on qualifying foreign-source business; no capital gains tax; no tax on IC dividends or distributions; no exchange controls; ICs paying annual SIFA license fees and maintaining economic substance achieve a 0% effective rate on offshore cotton brokerage profits

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa Company Income Tax Return (IRD Form CIT-1) filed through the Samoa Ministry of Revenue (MoR) e-Services electronic filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before 30 June following the 31 December income year-end (six months after fiscal year-end); substituted accounting periods require MoR prior approval

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: legal name, IC registration number, IRD number, registered agent details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the IC name exactly as shown on the SIFA certificate; IRD number is the SIFA registration number for exempt ICs

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income year and accounting period covered
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the 12-month accounting period used by the IC, normally 1 January to 31 December

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Residency and tax classification (resident ordinary company, IC, non-resident company)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mark IC; attach the IC exemption schedule and a copy of the International Company certificate

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total assessable income (all Samoa-source taxable income gross receipts)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert zero if no Samoa-source income was derived; foreign brokerage commissions on raw cotton bales are outside assessable income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt income (IC Act s.196 exemption)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the full amount of foreign-source income claimed as exempt and reconcile to bank statements and broker ledgers

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions (expenses incurred in producing assessable income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero where Box 4 is zero; maintain supporting invoices and contracts at the Samoa registered office

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses brought forward (max 5 income years)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Available only to taxable companies; exempt ICs leave blank or zero

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income (Box 4 minus Boxes 5, 6 and 7)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Result must be zero for a compliant exempt IC

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax at 27% on Box 8
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero for exempt ICs

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits (foreign tax credits, provisional tax, WHT credits)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs may not offset foreign income taxes against a nil Samoa liability

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable or refund due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nil for exempt ICs; payment must be made through MoR e-Services by the filing deadline

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration and signature of director or registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sign as director of the IC; misdeclaration of foreign-source status triggers fraud penalties

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of unpaid tax for each month or part-month up to 25%; penal interest at 1.5% per month on outstanding tax; fixed penalties up to WST 5,000 for failure to furnish returns; fraudulent misstatement attracts fines up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years under the Tax Administration Act 2015

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: SIFA Annual Return and Economic Substance (ES) Declaration filed through the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) online registry
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Return due within 30 days of the anniversary of incorporation; Economic Substance Declaration due within 12 months of the financial year-end as directed by SIFA guidance

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, registration number and date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the English-language legal name of the WS_IC; used for all treaty and bank references

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office in Samoa and licensed registered agent particulars
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be a licensed SIFA service provider; foreign directors rely on the agent for local filings

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose natural-person beneficial owners; opacity here triggers AML and shell-company red flags

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business activity and ISIC code (4620 cotton brokerage)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the offshore intermediary role in raw cotton bale export; confirm no domestic Samoa business is conducted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial summary (assets, turnover, net equity, expenditure in Samoa)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Summarise audited or internally prepared accounts; commission income from cotton bale sales must match bank flows

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance declaration: core income-generating activities (CIGAs) performed in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm contract negotiation, supplier/distributor risk management, invoicing and bookkeeping are directed and performed from Samoa

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical presence metadata: premises, number of local employees, annual local expenditure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the registered office lease and payroll records; proportionate staffing is mandatory for the distribution and service centre relevant activity

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC did not transact with Samoa residents or hold Samoa domestic property
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Breach of the domestic-business prohibition forfeits the tax exemption and attracts penalties

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late Annual Return penalties escalate from WST 100 to WST 1,000 plus strike-off of the IC after persistent default; failure to file the ES Declaration is a strict-liability offence with fines up to WST 500,000 and daily continuing penalties, plus deregistration and exchange of information with treaty partners

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% final withholding tax on dividends paid by a resident taxable company to non-residents; 0% on dividends and distributions paid by a compliant International Company pursuant to the IC Act 1987 exemption
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Under the Samoa-Australia and Samoa-New Zealand DTAs, dividend WHT is reduced to 5%-15% where the beneficial owner is a resident of the treaty partner and satisfies the shareholding holding period. Protocol: (a) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the Samoa Ministry of Revenue by filing Form TRC-1 with annual accounts; (b) provide the TRC and a Form WHT-T treaty relief declaration to the paying agent or source-country payer before the distribution date; (c) the Samoa payer files the withholding certificate with MoR on behalf of the non-resident; (d) refund claims must be made within the statutory time limits. IC distributions remain exempt without any treaty claim
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoa non-resident rates: interest 15% and royalties 15%. Treaty rates under the Samoa-Australia and Samoa-New Zealand DTAs generally reduce interest to 10%-15% and royalties to 10%-15% for arm's length IP usage, subject to TRC, beneficial ownership, and limitation-of-benefits clauses. Exempt ICs paying foreign lenders or licensors owe no Samoa withholding tax on outbound interest or royalties

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 aggregate related-party cross-border transactions per annum (administrative materiality threshold; the Income Tax Act 2015 imposes the arm's length standard without a statutory de minimis, and contemporaneous Master File/Local File documentation is mandatory above this level for taxable entities)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2017 and Regulations require every IC to file an annual ES declaration and maintain genuine substance in Samoa for relevant activities, including distribution and service centres and holding companies. An IC brokering raw cotton bales must demonstrate: meetings and decisions of the board in Samoa, CIGAs undertaken in Samoa (negotiation, contracting, invoicing, treasury management), adequate local premises and qualified employees, and annual local operating expenditure proportionate to income. ICs without substance are treated as shell companies; the exemption is denied and information is exchanged automatically with treaty partners

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion - Wrongful Claim of IC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deriving Samoa-source income, trading with Samoa residents, or holding Samoa domestic property while claiming the s.196 IC exemption; filing a CIT-1 return showing taxable income as nil while the IC in fact conducts domestic brokerage activities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of up to 6 years of concealed income at 27%; evasion penalty equal to 100%-200% of tax evaded; penal interest at 1.5% per month; criminal fine up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years for fraudulent returns
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent may be personally assessed where the IC is a facade; courts may issue travel bans, asset preservation orders, and director disqualification orders

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the annual SIFA ES declaration; booking large cotton brokerage commissions through Samoa without directors' meetings, local employees, premises, or CIGAs in Samoa
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to WST 500,000 plus continuing daily penalties; mandatory strike-off of the IC; automatic exchange of information with tax authorities of the parent/shareholder jurisdiction, triggering follow-on assessments abroad
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Knowingly signing a false ES declaration is an offence; directors face personal fines, disqualification from acting as directors of any Samoa company, and loss of the corporate veil in subsequent recovery proceedings

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC as an opaque conduit for third-party cotton trade payments, failing to maintain the beneficial ownership register, or accepting unidentified client funds through the Samoa bank account
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Anti-money laundering fines up to WST 2,000,000 for body corporates; confiscation of transaction proceeds; deregistration of the IC and freezing of Samoa bank accounts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and nominee shareholders face criminal liability for money laundering with imprisonment up to 14 years; travel bans and extradition cooperation apply for predicate trade fraud

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Mispricing intercompany purchases or sales of raw cotton bales, circular back-to-back invoicing to shift profit to zero-tax jurisdictions, or paying non-arm's length commissions to connected brokers
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Arm's length re-adjustment, additional tax at 27%, accuracy-related penalties up to 100% of the adjustment, and penal interest; comparable documentation must be produced within 30 days of MoR notice
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false invoices or transfer pricing returns are jointly and severally liable for the tax shortfall; criminal sanctions apply for fraudulent trade mis-invoicing
